transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I just... I keep feeling like I ruined things for everybody. Like... I don't know, like I'm a fake in my apprenticeship. I just feel like I let my family down, and the newer apprentices, over... just stuff. Stuff I know other people would probably just fix and move on from. But... yeah. That's why I'm here, I guess.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time lately?
Um... I don't know. I guess maybe? I haven't really... thought about it like that. I just... I don't know.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Um... not really, no. I mean... I have a sketchbook I used to use a lot, but I just walk past it now. And I haven't been going to volleyball. Or answering the texts for my volunteer group. I just... I don't really feel much about it anymore. I used to really like that stuff, but now I just... ignore it.
Do you often feel guilty?

Um... yeah. Like I said earlier, I just... I feel like I let everyone down. My family, the younger apprentices... I just feel like a fake. Over stuff that shouldn't even matter that much. So... yeah, I guess so.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Um... yeah. I mean, I think that's... kind of what I just said. With the sketchbook and volleyball and everything. I just... I don't really care about any of it right now.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... a while, I guess. Maybe... nine months? Give or take. I tried to just deal with it for a long time, but... it got harder to cover up when my classes and my apprenticeship stuff started falling behind.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that normally would give you pleasure?

Yeah... I mean, kind of what I was saying. I just... I can walk right past my sketchbook or skip volleyball entirely. I even ignore texts from my volunteer group. I just... I don't feel much of anything from them anymore, even though they used to be what made me feel like... me.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't really been paying attention to it, but... I don't think so.
Have you had periods like this before in your life?
Um... I don't know. Maybe? I guess I haven't really thought about it. I mean, I've had times where I felt a little off, but... I don't really remember it being exactly like this.
Have you had times like this before in your life that went away and then came back?
I... I'm not sure. I mean, I guess I've felt down before, but... I don't know if it went away and came back. I just don't remember.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt this way?
I really couldn't tell you. Um... it's hard to keep track of that kind of thing. I just... I don't really count how many times.
Is this the first time in your life you've felt this way?
I suppose it could be. I just... I don't really sit around analyzing it. So... maybe? I really don't have a clear answer for you.
Have you had another period like this in your life before the past nine months?
I... I really don't know. Nine months is a long time to think back on. I just... I don't remember if it was like this before then.
Have you ever felt this way for an extended period before the past nine months?
I don't think so. I mean, it's hard to say for sure, but... no, nothing really stands out. I just don't remember feeling exactly like this before.
Have you had another period like this in your life before the past nine months?
Um... I thought I just answered that. No. Not that I can remember, anyway. I just... I don't really have a different answer for you.
Have you had an episode like this before in your life that went away on its own?
I... look, no. Like I just said, I haven't felt like this before. So... no.
Have you had any periods like this before that went away and then came back?
I really haven't. I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing... I told you, this is the first time I've felt this way.
Have you had any other episodes of feeling this way that went away before this one started?
...No. I don't know what else to tell you. Just... no.
Have you had any episodes like this that went away before this one started?
I... look, I just answered that. It's still no. I really don't have anything else to add.
Have you had any episodes like this before that went away on their own?
I... I really don't understand why you're asking me this again. I already said no. I haven't.
